{{Quote|The Empire has broken into six, maybe ten major fragments, ruled by warlords and Governors. The Senate's in control of Coruscant and most of the Inner Rim. A New Republic has been established and is growing strong.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="cotj">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|Thanks to you, the weakling Jedi who scorned me will soon be erased from history, replaced by a new race of warriors; strong warriors, warriors who know that the Force is not a shield to protect the useless&hellip; but is, in reality, a weapon&hellip; to empower the worthy!|Desann to [[Kyle Katarn]]|audio=Desannthanks.flac|<ref name="JK2:JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>}}
*Luke Skywalker's former apprentice, [[Desann]], tried to destroy the [[Jedi Praxeum]] with his own personal army of artificially Force-empowered [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[shadowtrooper]]s.<ref name="JK2:JO" />
*[[Kyle Katarn]] returned to the Jedi Praxeum.<ref name="JK2:JO" />
*The [[Dreaming River Clan]] was captured by Imperial forces and subsequently freed by [[Kir Kanos]].<ref name="Nightsaber">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031120nightsaber|text=Nightsaber|int=Nightsaber}}</ref>
*[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]] moved his military forces to the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]].<ref name="cotj" />
*[[Ismaren plot]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="cotj" />
*[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] killed the Imperial warlords, [[Imperial Reunification|unifying]] the Imperial forces in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], with the exemption of the [[Restored Empire]].<ref name="ds" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*Admiral Gilad Pellaeon annexed the [[Pentastar Alignment]] into the Imperial Remnant and seized the [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']].<ref name="TEA" />
*The [[Crimson Empire]] is absorbed into the Imperial Remnant.
*The [[Imperial Civil War]] ends.<ref name="ds" />
*The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] led by [[Durga Besadii Tai]] completed the construction of the [[Darksaber (superweapon)|Darksaber]].<ref name="ds" />
*[[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]] reemerged on [[Corbos]] and were destroyed by [[Kyp Durron]].<ref name="Leviathan">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Academy: Leviathan]]''</ref>
*[[Borga Besadii Diori]] became the leader of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].
*The [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]; [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]] was replaced by the New Republic-appointed [[Governor/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Micamberlecto]] of [[Froz]].
*[[Pter Thanas]] and [[Gaeriel Captison]] wedded on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].
*The [[Eye of Palpatine]] is destroyed.
